settings.question: IS THIS KIT ROYALTY FREE?
settings.answer: All sounds and samples in this kit are royalty free under 1,000,000 streams or unless major placement.

settings.question: HOW DO I GET THE FILES?
settings.answer: After purchasing, you're taken to a page where you can download the files, and you will also receive an email with a link to download all the files. The link in your email never expires. If you run into any issues, you can contact us.

settings.question: DOES IT WORK IN ANY DAW?
settings.answer: Yes, the files within the kit are either audio files or MIDI files that can be opened in any DAW.

settings.question: WHAT'S YOUR REFUND POLICY?
settings.answer: Since this is a digital product, it cannot be returned or refunded.
